OPENING QUESTION

Have you heard of
AI Agents?

ChatGPT answers. But what if AI could actually do the work?

Ask students: “Who has used ChatGPT?” → “Who has heard the term AI Agent?”

WHY AGENTS NOW?

AI moved from talking to acting

2022 AI became easy to talk to ChatGPT made conversational AI feel normal.
2022–23 AI started to reason and act Think → Act → Observe → Think again.
2023 AI started using tools Search, files, APIs, code execution.
2024 → AI started using computers Click, type, run commands, change files.

THE KEY CHANGE

From “answer this” to “do this”

Chatbotanswers questions
→
Agentuses tools and takes action

The difference is not intelligence only.
The difference is access to tools.

SIMPLE DEFINITION

An AI Agent is AI with hands

  • It understands your goal
  • It chooses tools
  • It executes actions
  • It checks the result and continues
A chatbot can say, “Here is how.” An agent can say, “Done.”

TODAY’S PLAN

We are not training a new AI model

We are giving an existing AI model tools and an environment where it can act.

BrainNemotron — the model that thinks
AgentHermes — the assistant that acts
BuilderOpenCode — the tool that helps us install it

Wake Up Your Assistant

By the end of today, your own AI assistant will answer you on your phone.

WHAT WE’RE INSTALLING TODAY

Three things

OpenCode A tool that writes code for you Today, we’ll use it to install Hermes.
Hermes My personal assistant — today’s main character It keeps running even after class ends.
Nemotron The brain — a model NVIDIA lets us use for free The brain the other two use to think.

① OpenCode

A tool that writes code for you

It runs in the terminal. Tell it what you want, and it writes code, runs commands, and creates files. Open source and free.

Today, we’re going to have OpenCode install Hermes for us

② NVIDIA FREE API

We borrow the brain

Running a large AI model requires a very powerful computer. A laptop isn’t enough.

  • Get one API key for free at build.nvidia.com
  • That one key gives access to the entire catalog
Why is it free? NVIDIA sells GPUs. The more people build with AI, the more GPUs get used and sold.

② CHOOSING A MODEL

Why Ultra?

TierSizeBest for
Nano30BFast
Super100BBalanced
Ultra550BBuilt for agents
NVIDIA also labels it for agent use. It is good at choosing and using tools.

③ Hermes Agent

Today’s main character

  • 40+ tools — files, web, code execution
  • Connects to messengers — Telegram, WhatsApp
  • Remembers — you and what happened before
  • Gets better as you use it — saves repeated tasks as skills

PAUSE · TAKE OUT A PIECE OF PAPER

Write just three lines

  • What do I repeat every week?
  • What is a one-time task that takes a long time?
  • What do I want to do but can’t because I lack the skills?
Within five days, your assistant will do one of these for you. Do not throw this paper away.

NOW, LET’S INSTALL

Eight steps

  • Check Node
  • Install OpenCode
  • Verify in a new window
  • Create an NVIDIA API key
  • Run OpenCode → /connect
  • Choose a model
We’ll go slowly, one step at a time, together.

STEP 1 · PREP

Check whether Node is installed

macOS — Terminal

node -v

Windows — Command Prompt

node -v
If you see v20 or higher, you’re good. Skip the next slide.

STEP 1-b · IF YOU DON’T HAVE NODE

Download it from nodejs.org

  • Go to nodejs.org
  • Click the LTS button (green)
  • Run the downloaded file → keep clicking Next
  • After installation, open a new terminal window and run node -v
On Windows, leave the “Add to PATH” option checked during installation.

STEP 2 · INSTALL

Install OpenCode

npm install -g opencode-ai

Use the same command on both Mac and Windows.

If you get a permission error on Mac, add sudo at the beginning.

STEP 2 · ALTERNATIVE

If npm doesn’t work, use this

macOS

curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash

Windows (PowerShell)

irm https://opencode.ai/install.ps1 | iex
Only one method needs to work. If you already installed it, ignore this slide.

STEP 3 · VERIFY

Close the window and open a new one

opencode --version

If you see a version number, it worked.

command not found does not necessarily mean failure. Your terminal may still be using the old environment.

STEP 4 · NVIDIA API KEY

Go to build.nvidia.com

You can search for it too. It should be the first result.

Create an account and complete email verification.

STEP 4-b · NVIDIA API KEY

Top-right profile → API Keys

The menu shows Up to 40 rpm — that means up to 40 requests per minute.

STEP 4-c · NVIDIA API KEY

Generate API Key

Click the green button to generate a key that starts with nvapi-.

Treat it like a password. You may not be able to see it again after closing the window, so paste it into a temporary note.

STEP 5 · RUN

Launch OpenCode

opencode

A large logo will appear, with a Tip Run /connect message below it.

STEP 6 · CONNECT

Enter the slash command

/connect

As soon as you enter it, Connect provider appears above. Press Enter.

STEP 6-b · CONNECT

Choose Nvidia

  • Type just nv in the Search box to filter the list
  • Use ↑↓ to highlight Nvidia, then press Enter
There are many similar names. Double-check before selecting.

STEP 6-c · CONNECT

Paste the API key

Paste the nvapi- key and press Enter.

It may not appear on screen, and that is normal. Watch out for spaces before or after the key.

STEP 7 · MODEL

Nemotron 3 Ultra

Choose Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B A55B from the list.

Choose the longer name. Ultra, not Nano.

STEP 7-b · MODEL

Select variant → Default

high / max think longer but are slower. Use Default for this class.

STEP 8 · VERIFY

Start a conversation

Hi! Who are you?

If you see Nemotron at the bottom and get a response, it worked.

That’s the first half of today. Now we’re going to give it real work to do.

TODAY’S KEY IDEA

Now we’ll have OpenCode
install Hermes

You don’t need to know how to install it. The documentation has the instructions, and OpenCode can read them.

HERMES SETUP · PROMPT

Paste one prompt into OpenCode

The full setup prompts are embedded in this slide deck. Choose your OS, copy the whole prompt, paste it into OpenCode, and press Enter.

macOS

Apple Silicon and Intel supported.
Note: the macOS paths/commands were derived from Hermes source code and were not verified end-to-end on a Mac.
# Prompt to paste into opencode — macOS Install **Hermes Agent** (Nous Research) on this Mac and configure it to match the **reference spec** below. The reference spec was extracted from another laptop that is already working correctly. Don't guess — match these values exactly. > ⚠️ **Provenance of this file, stated up front (important):** > The reference laptop is a **Windows** machine. So the paths/commands in this macOS document were > extracted directly from the Hermes source code and have **not been verified end-to-end on an > actual Mac.** > - `HERMES_HOME = ~/.hermes` → `hermes_constants.py:53-59`, `scripts/install.sh:48` > - Code location `~/.hermes/hermes-agent` → `scripts/install.sh:447` > - uv at `~/.hermes/bin/uv` → `scripts/install.sh:560` > - Node at `~/.hermes/node/bin/node` (POSIX layout) → `hermes_constants.py:285-301`, `install.sh:815-817, 927-942` > - Python 3.11 / Node 22 targets → `scripts/install.sh:59-60` > - `requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.14"` → `pyproject.toml:15` > > Version numbers (v0.19.1, Python 3.11.15) and the model list come from the reference laptop and

Windows

Native Windows only — not WSL.
The prompt checks Python, ripgrep, Node, NVIDIA NIM, and the Hermes configuration.
# Prompt to paste into opencode — Windows Install **Hermes Agent** (Nous Research) on this Windows laptop and configure it to match the **reference spec** below. The reference spec was extracted from another laptop that is already working correctly. Don't guess — match these values exactly. --- ## Reference spec (target state) | Item | Value | |---|---| | Product | Hermes Agent v0.19.1 (2026-07-30) or newer, install method = `git` | | Platform | Native Windows (not WSL) | | HERMES_HOME | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes` | | Code location | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\hermes-agent` (contains venv) |

WHAT THE PROMPT DOES

OpenCode handles the setup step by step

  • Checks the existing environment before changing anything
  • Installs Hermes Agent and verifies the Python / Node requirements
  • Configures NVIDIA NIM as the provider
  • Pins nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b
  • Runs verification instead of assuming the install worked
If OpenCode asks you for the NVIDIA API key, paste your own nvapi-... key. Never paste a placeholder.

PASTE IT IN

Copy → Paste into OpenCode → Enter

Do not rewrite the prompt. Paste the whole thing so OpenCode has the OS-specific checks, paths, and recovery steps.

Then read the screen while it works. If it reports a mismatch or asks you to do something manually, follow that instruction before continuing.

WHAT JUST HAPPENED?

An agent
installed another agent

You don’t have to be the person who already knows how. You need to be able to explain what you want done.

VERIFY · FIRST CONVERSATION

Launch your assistant

hermes

Talk to it. If it answers, verification is complete.

401 → API key issue (check for extra spaces)
model not found → Check the model name

VERIFY · THE REAL TEST

Don’t just chat — give it a task

Create test.txt in this folder and write my name in it.

Then open the folder yourself.

The file is really there. You just recreated this morning’s demo yourself.

WARNING

It can actually change things on your computer

If you tell it to delete something, it will. This is not a simulation.

Only ask it to do things you can undo

For today, work only inside a practice folder. Do not point it at your real documents, photos, or assignment folders.

FINAL STEP

Connect it to your phone

hermes gateway setup
hermes gateway start

Now talk to it from your phone.

The laptop does the work; you give instructions from your pocket.
